GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (UltimateDefend.cs:13) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (UltimateDefend.cs:22-25) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalTags.rationale: `new HashSet<CardTag> { CardTag.Defend }` (UltimateDefend.cs:18) == the tag set, and the source's own comment says why it matters: "Yes, Ultimate Defend counts as a Defend for the purposes of effects like Fasten." The sim's `defend` tag is what card/fasten's FastenPower and the Fortified enchantment (enchantments.py:287-289, moved from :286-287 -- content re-verified current, same `"defend" in card.tags` check) key on, so this is load-bearing rather than cosmetic.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(11m, ValueProp.Move)` (UltimateDefend.cs:20) == `_block = 11`. Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius.

OnPlay.rationale: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` (UltimateDefend.cs:34) == `BlockCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._block, card=self)`. A single-effect card with no guards and no animation on either side -- card/defend with bigger numbers.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Block.UpgradeValueBy(4m)` (UltimateDefend.cs:29) == `self._block += 4` (11 -> 15). Note C# declares OnUpgrade before OnPlay in this file; no behavioural consequence.
